#    identifies the code point as a unified form rather than the specific glyph
#  * the description corresponds to the key derived by `gaiji::parse_gaiji_body`
#    from the marker body: quoted text for 「…」 with an empty or 、-led tail,

#    aozora-gaiji-special.tsv) are omitted, as are keys with unbalanced 「」, a

#    multiple code points for a single key

#    character that does not appear inside markers in the archive; rows
